audit.why: 52.21% over 1471 games; EVEN 5.5/10 is right overall, but the lane is not flat — Lissandra owns everything up to level 6 against an immobile, mana-hungry Anivia and loses the scaling half.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; the early/late split is now carried by the level chart instead of a flat 'Skill' row set.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read 'Skill' on all seven rows while win[0..4]='Lissandra' and win[5..6]='Anivia', matching the packet levelChart. Every row disagreed with the content layer.
audit.why: Anivia has no dash, pays 80 mana per Flash Frost and only spikes with mana items; Lissandra's level 3 and level 6 windows are real, and Anivia's item scaling with a 4/3/2 Glacial Storm and a 17s wall is real too.
audit.corrected: Moved all seven phases[N].side to the packet values as one atomic group, re-rated them, and rewrote every why to match. win[0..6] already carried the correct values so no cross-layer disagreement is introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only vaguely: Frostbite doubles its damage against a target recently hit by Flash Frost or standing in a fully formed Glacial Storm. Crystallize's flat 17s and the egg were never given numbers or sequencing.
audit.why: Riot text on E: 'If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.' Riot text on W gives a wall that blocks all movement; P reverts her to an egg.
audit.corrected: Written into enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why with the real cooldowns (Q 11s at rank 1, E 4s, W 17s flat, R 4/3/2).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit and the packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7, Frostbite 4s flat, Crystallize 17s flat, Glacial Storm 4/3/2, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns as an explicit wait-for-X-then-Y line and added the numbers into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
